title: WikiCREM: A Large Unsupervised Corpus for Coreference Resolution

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (F1-score or accuracy) on masculine versus feminine subsets (e.g., GAP dataset), and evaluating the difference in performance between pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical examples involving occupations and pronoun genders (e.g., WinoBias and WinoGender datasets).
